messages:
sophie: Quick ask — can we get a 1-page manager checklist + a 3-line self-review template for the Q2 performance cycle? Training for managers next Wed, want a concise handout.

elaine: TL;DR draft below. kept it intentionally short for slide handout / manager pocket guide. Feel free to trim.

elaine: MANAGER: Q2 calibration checklist (1-page)
- Quick prep (15m): review each direct's 3-line self-review + recent deliverables.
- Anchor to outcomes, not activity: ask for measurable impact (metrics, user outcomes).
- Calibration questions: Is performance level consistent across peers? Any systemic blockers?
- Strengths & development: note 1 clear strength, 1 growth area (concrete example).
- Signals for stretch vs. stable: runway, dependencies, cross-team impact.
- Feedback loop: agree 1 next-step + follow-up date, add to 1:1 agenda.
- Documentation: update People Ops calibration sheet row and mark any role/scale changes.

elaine: 3-line SELF-REVIEW (keep each line max 1 sentence)
```
1) What I shipped and the impact (metric or user outcome)
2) What I learned or adjusted (skill/process change)
3) One priority for next quarter + what I need from my manager/team
```

elaine: EXAMPLES — short
- Shipped: launched vector search proto, reduced median query latency 40% for search flows.
- Learned: improved prompt eval cadence; started weekly regression checks.
- Next: focus on batching improvements; need time + a profiling session.

mike: this is great. small suggestion: add a one-line prompt managers can use in 1:1 to unblock calibration: "Give one concrete example that separates this person's performance from peers."

elaine: good call — adding as a follow-up prompt in the checklist.

people-ops-bot: Reminder: Q2 self-review window opens 2024-04-15 and closes 2024-04-29. Template link: https://intranet.redwood/people/self-review-template

jordan: I'll drop this into the manager-training slides and produce a printable 1-pager by EOD tomorrow. will ping when ready.

sophie: Perfect — thanks everyone. If you can keep the 1-pager under one A4 and the self-review as the three-line snippet, that’ll be ideal for drop-in training. :thumbsup:

mike: i'll review the slide copy before you finalize, jordan.

jordan: noted — will send for review in #manager-readouts.

sophie: planning to share with people managers after training; can we also add the calibration question mike suggested to the shared rubric?

elaine: done — updated the rubric and left a short comment explaining intent.

sophie: awesome, closing this thread — thanks for the quick turn. :sparkles:
